posts.title: Sportsman class for old-school D&D
posts.description: HP as Fighter +1 AB as Cleric 9 AC Throwing weapons +1 Moves at 240' Can only use club and javelin Homerun: Once per L2 Spell as per Wizard a Sportsman can make an attack roll to deflect a projectile and knock it back Knows Ball: Once during the campaign, a Sportsman can understand something by asking the referee.
